title: Story 1.4 M2b: update-channel proof, idempotence, and drift canary on the primary host
summary: On the adopted primary host (applied revision stale bd9d9fb, checkout pulled to successor merge SHA 8a7cbc1): verify UPDATE_AVAILABLE detection, execute the kit's update transaction under delegated plan approval with preservation before/after hashing, explicit live verification at correct scopes with ROUTE_READY remaining NOT_EVALUATED, a second no-churn update run proving idempotence by hash comparison, and the non-secret kit-owned drift canary cycle: LOCAL_DRIFT detection, update refusal without overwriting, byte-exact restoration, healthy re-verification. Mutations only through kit transactions plus the enumerated canary steps; permissive flags forbidden; unexpected refusals stop lanes.
